next_repair_spec_input_pack.usage: Input for next-phase repair SPEC design. NOT executable. Contains generic requirements only.

requirement_1.title: Expand authorization mutations to concrete owner/non-owner actor pairs
requirement_1.description: When AUTHORIZATION_MATRIX mechanism generates mutations, it must enumerate concrete actor combinations from: (a) entity ownership relation (entity.owner_field → Actor), (b) declared test accounts per role. For each authorization rule targeting operation O on entity E with owner field F: generate (owner_actor, O, E) as control and (non_owner_actor, O, E) as treatment.
requirement_1.input_source: Behavior IR entity ownership relations + declared test actors
requirement_1.output: Concrete actor-pair mutations bound to specific test accounts
requirement_1.constraint: Must remain generic - derive actor pairs from entity relations, not from hardcoded names

requirement_2.title: Expand tenant isolation mutations to per-tenant actor combinations
requirement_2.description: When TENANT_ISOLATION_MATRIX mechanism generates mutations, it must bind concrete per-tenant actors for: (a) READ operations: call with tenant-B actor, verify only tenant-A resources returned; (b) LIST operations: call with tenant-A actor, verify response contains only tenant-A entities; (c) WRITE operations: attempt cross-tenant modification.
requirement_2.input_source: Behavior IR tenant relations + multi-tenant test accounts
requirement_2.output: Per-tenant actor mutations with expected isolation assertions
requirement_2.constraint: Must use declared tenant test accounts from project input, not infer tenant names

requirement_3.title: Support resource-creator vs other-user pattern for DELETE operations
requirement_3.description: For DELETE operations on resources with uploaded_by/created_by field: generate (creator_actor deletes own resource) as control and (other_actor deletes creator's resource) as treatment. Requires fixture setup: creator creates resource first, then other user attempts delete.
requirement_3.output: Two-actor delete experiment with fixture dependency
requirement_3.constraint: Generic pattern: any entity with creator/uploader field + DELETE operation

requirement_4.title: Cap actor variants per rule to prevent experiment explosion
requirement_4.description: Actor expansion may multiply experiments. Apply per-rule cap: maximum 4 actor combinations per authorization/tenant rule. Priority order: (1) owner vs non-owner, (2) cross-tenant pair, (3) creator vs other, (4) role-level fallback.
requirement_4.constraint: Default cap = 4, configurable. Must not reduce below 2 (control + treatment).

regression_constraints.project_d_tp_retention: All 12 existing TPs must remain unaffected

after_repair_must_hold: Actor expansion generates experiments for ≥4 of 6 affected operations
No hardcoded entity names, actor names, or project-specific mappings
Per-rule actor cap prevents explosion beyond budget
Generic pattern works for any multi-tenant system with ownership relations

theoretical_gain.note: Upper bound only. Actual gain depends on execution success and oracle correctness.
